description:
- 10-15 minutes to all the excitement of Broadway and Downtown Nashville
- Private balcony with comfortable outdoor seating
- Four bedrooms, primary features an attached ensuite

The space
Last Rodeo Suite 2: The Ultimate Nashville Bachelorette Retreat

Welcome to Last Rodeo Suite 2—your private, pink-hued paradise designed for the ultimate Nashville bachelorette party! Just 10-15 minutes from Broadway’s neon lights and live music scene, this stylish four-bedroom retreat is the perfect blend of chic, fun, and effortlessly photo-worthy.

Step inside and be greeted by a vibrant, feminine aesthetic inspired by Nashville’s charm. From playful pops of pink to curated decor, every detail has been designed with your squad in mind. The spacious living room is made for group hangs, complete with a cozy sofa, a record player to set the vibe, and a TV for winding down with your favorite rom-coms.

The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need for celebratory toasts and late-night snacks, plus barstool seating and a dining area for six—perfect for sipping mimosas before hitting the town. Upstairs, an additional lounge space with two plush sofas and a second TV offers even more room to relax between outings.

When it’s time to get ready for the night ahead, you’ll love the group-friendly layout with a Glam Room and well-lit mirrors—because getting glam together is part of the fun! The primary bedroom features an ensuite bathroom, while three additional bedrooms and multiple bathrooms ensure no one is waiting too long to freshen up. The bunk room is a slumber party dream, ideal for bonding with your besties.

Start the morning with coffee on your private balcony, spend the day exploring Music City, and return to your bachelorette hideaway for a toast under the twinkle of city lights on the stunning rooftop. At Last Rodeo Suite 2, every detail is designed to make your celebration unforgettable.

Get ready to experience Nashville in style—Last Rodeo Suite 2 is waiting for you and your girls! Need even more space? Last Rodeo Suite 1 is also available to book!

East Nashville is one of Nashville's oldest neighborhoods, located just across the Cumberland River. Known for its eclectic and artsy atmosphere, you'll find some of the city's best restaurants, live music venues, shopping, and easy access to Nissan Stadium. Bonus: all of the excitement of Broadway is just a 10-minute Uber drive away. Don't be surprised if you see one of your favorite musicians walking around this neighborhood, as many of them call it home!

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style.
